rfid_inventory.description: sessions=[1] uses dual-antenna fast-switch (0x8A). gapless=true uses the SDK-style continuous re-armed scan: the reader inventories without idle gaps or inter-pass cooldowns and stops as soon as the unique-tag set is stable for settle_ms (no new EPC), capped at max_seconds. This replaces the fixed scan_passes x pass_duration schedule when gapless=true (scan_passes/pass_duration/cooldown then only apply to the legacy fallback). Multi-session (sessions=[0,1,2,3]) added ZERO tags on hardware while costing ~55% more time, so it stays disabled.
